description: This file defines the 'Folder' class, representing a logical container for documents within a local wallet application. It provides serialization methods for database persistence and includes metadata annotations. The class includes properties such as id, name, description, createdAt, and updatedAt, along with factory and utility methods.

classes.name: Folder
classes.description: A data model class representing a folder that contains documents. It includes properties for identification, description, timestamps, and serialization methods.

methods.name: Folder.fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a Folder instance from a database row map.

methods.name: Folder.toMap
methods.description: Converts the Folder instance to a database map suitable for persistence.

methods.name: Folder.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Folder instance with optional updated fields.
